exits.label: Door
exits.text: Romeo opens the apartment door. The hall waits colder than it should.

onEnter.text: Apartment 708 still knows Romeo's shape. For now, the room is bright enough to lie.

#ff0000.label: Door
#ff0000.text: The door is heavy, but not locked. The hallway on the other side has been listening.

#00ff00.label: Desk
#00ff00.text: Old bills, half-written lyrics, and a note in Romeo's own handwriting: If I forget, check the books.

#ff8800.label: Flag
#ff8800.text: A Chilean flag, pinned up like proof somebody here still believed in places. Romeo looks at it longer than he means to.

#0000ff.label: Bed
#0000ff.text: The sheets smell like cold sweat and cheap detergent. Somebody slept badly here.

#ffff00.label: Table
#ffff00.text: A battlefield of mugs, paper, and things nobody wanted to throw away.

#ff00ff.label: Window
#ff00ff.text: Snow crawls down the glass. Outside has the decency to stay outside.

#00ffff.label: Television
#00ffff.text: Dead screen. Heavy glass. The kind of silence that used to mean late-night movies.

#380f04.label: Lamp
#380f04.text: The lamp keeps its small promise. Warmth, a little circle of it, and nothing more.

#808080.label: Punchingbag
#808080.text: Judging by the dents, somebody was training for the end of the world.

#ffffff.label: Books
#ffffff.text: Between two swollen paperbacks, Romeo finds a small key taped to the inside cover.
#ffffff.repeatText: Apparently the chosen one only needed friendship, courage, and a legendary blade.

#955746.label: Jacket
#955746.text: It is Romeo's jacket, but after all of this, it feels like it belongs to someone he used to be.

#042d0e.label: Picture
#042d0e.text: Romeo remembers hiding something before sleep became impossible.

#26863d.label: VHS
#26863d.text: The tape label reads: DO NOT LOSE THE SMALL ONE. Romeo hates when past Romeo is vague.

#161d47.label: Pictures
#161d47.text: Pictures from a cleaner life. Romeo studies them like evidence from a case he already lost.

#2d3c9e.label: Heater
#2d3c9e.text: At least something in this place still remembers how to be warm.
